name: Synfig
category: A7. Native applications and procedural tools
role: synfig CLI renders .sif and .sifz 2D vector animation projects to frames or video
summary: Open-source 2D vector and bitmap animation system. The synfig CLI renders .sif, .sifz and .sfg project files to PNG sequences, GIF or video at chosen size and frame range. The Homebrew formula provides a standalone renderer on macOS; the Studio GUI and broader animation workflows are separate from this CLI validation.
use_when: An existing .sif project from an animator must render headlessly
Vector tweening and bone rigs authored visually, over Blender grease pencil
Frame-range renders of a 2D project to PNG with alpha
avoid_when: Need a code-authored vector scene: SVG, Anime.js or Motion Canvas
notes: 2026-11-16: Homebrew formula 1.5.5_4 installs the standalone Synfig CLI on macOS arm64. One static SIF-to-PNG render passed; a missing optional mod_jpeg module warning appeared, but the PNG target worked. This does not validate Studio GUI, animation ranges or video output.

evidence.result: Rendered a 160x120 PNG with a red center pixel [255,0,0,255], transparent corner [0,0,0,0], and identical repeated file SHA-256.
evidence.scope: Static SIF rectangle rendered to PNG at 0s on macOS arm64; no animation, GUI, video output or other render targets.

assessment.rationale: 1.5.5 released 2026-03-16. The cask is disabled, but a Homebrew formula provides the CLI; one static PNG render is now validated on macOS arm64.
